 Lakers Need Mamukelashvili to Ease Doncic's Scoring Burden

 Nov 21, 2026 - 16:45

 Nov. 1, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Lakers forward Sandro Mamukelashvili (54) high-fives guard Luka Doncic (77) during the first half at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Jonathan Hui-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect 
 Smallest Font 
 Largest Font 
 The Los Angeles Lakers need stronger offensive contributions from Sandro Mamukelashvili as Luka Doncic continues carrying a significant scoring responsibility during Austin Reaves' absence. In an article published November 20, 2026, Lakeshowlife.com highlighted Mamukelashvili's recent shooting struggles as an obstacle to improving the team's offensive balance.
 Reaves has missed four consecutive games because of a left heel bruise, leaving Doncic with additional responsibilities on offense. Although Quentin Grimes has performed admirably in Reaves' absence, the Lakers still need more consistent production from other players, according to Lakeshowlife.com.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 Mamukelashvili has averaged just 4.3 points over his last three games while shooting 15.4 percent from the field. His recent performances have fallen considerably short of the offensive contribution expected when he joined the Lakers.
 Also Read 
 Lakers Clear Doncic, Rule Out Reaves Against Jazz 
 The forward's shooting difficulties continued against the Utah Jazz, where he finished with just one field goal on 10 attempts. A dunk during the game provided one of the few positive moments in an otherwise difficult offensive performance.
 His struggles also extended to the preceding matchups. Mamukelashvili went 1-for-8 against the Charlotte Hornets before shooting 2-for-8 against the Phoenix Suns, according to Lakeshowlife.com.
 Those performances contrast sharply with his earlier offensive production. Mamukelashvili previously scored 23 points against the Atlanta Hawks and connected on five three-pointers against the Milwaukee Bucks.
 Also Read 
 Quentin Grimes Powers Lakers With Historic 47 Point Performance 
 Beyond his ability to score, Mamukelashvili can contribute by handling the ball and attacking opposing defenses. These abilities could create additional scoring opportunities for teammates and reduce the pressure on Doncic to generate nearly every offensive possession.
 Doncic remains the Lakers' primary offensive force despite his recent shooting difficulties. According to the figures cited by Lakeshowlife.com, he is averaging 38 points, seven rebounds and eight assists for the season.
 However, his production has not eliminated the need for additional offensive support. The Lakers continue to rely heavily on him while Reaves remains unavailable, making contributions from the rest of the roster increasingly important.
 Also Read 
 GTA VI Release Raises Gaming Concerns for NBA Teams 
 Head coach JJ Redick has also acknowledged the offensive demands placed on Doncic. Following the superstar's consecutive shooting struggles, Redick expressed sympathy for the workload created by Reaves' continued absence.
 Doncic, meanwhile, did not use the team's difficulties as an excuse following the loss of form against Utah. He acknowledged the need to provide better leadership, according to Lakeshowlife.com.
 With Reaves still sidelined, Mamukelashvili's ability to recover his shooting touch and contribute consistently remains an important factor in the Lakers' offensive rotation.
